effect.name: GM Volumetric Sweep
effect.desc: Soft directional light volume controlled by center, width and falloff.
effect.shader: const vec3 L=vec3(0.2126,0.7152,0.0722);void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 c=(acLayerCenter-center*vec2(-1.0))/acScreenSize;vec2 d=vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle));vec2 q=u-c;float across=abs(dot(q,vec2(-d.y,d.x)));float forward=max(dot(q,d),0.0);float beam=exp(-pow(across/max(width,0.0001),2.0))*exp(-forward*falloff);vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);float gate=0.25+0.75*dot(s.rgb,L);gl_FragColor=vec4(s.rgb+lightColor.rgb*beam*strength*gate,s.a);}
